KPlugin.Name: DingTalk: bring popups to front
KPlugin.Description: DingTalk (Linux, XWayland) maps its dialogs, popped-out chats and tray menu as independent toplevels with no activation token, so KWin's focus-stealing prevention leaves them behind, and its tray menu is placed at a random position. This script activates those windows when they appear and parks the tray menu next to the pointer.
KPlugin.Author: Yatao Li
